expect_red: isolate then isolate off restores the prior view exactly, ghosts included

mutations.contract: `isolate off` puts every open part back as the snapshot recorded it -- drawn, hidden, ghosted -- and hides any part opened since.
mutations.note: The mutation restores every part as hidden and solid, which is the trap Isolate was: everything else gone and no way back to what was drawn.
mutations.find: return { sha: sha, visible: r ? !!r.visible : false, ghost: r ? !!r.ghost : false };
mutations.replace: return { sha: sha, visible: false, ghost: false };
